The affix टेण्यण् comes after the word वृक , a class of persons living by trade of arms.

Terms: टेण्यण्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affixes तिल् and तातिल् come after 1. वृक and 2. ज्येष्ठ when excellence is denoted.

Terms: तिल् and तातिल् - छन्दस्

The word विष्टर is irregularly formed in the sense of 'tree' and 'seat'.

Terms: ष change
